description: Apply a previously previewed edit. Pass the `previewId` returned by `edit_note` with `dryRun: true`. Previews expire after 5 minutes. Fails with a descriptive error if the target file changed since the preview was generated — in that case, regenerate the preview and try again.

previewId.description: The previewId returned by `edit_note` with `dryRun: true`.

name: apply_edit_preview
